messages.text:
At 12¢ the 40T runs about $56 a month in power, and it's $799. It draws for a full block every ten minutes, year round, and stacks sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
First.  Can I solo mine and pool mine at the same time

Not at the same time on one unit — it points at one pool at a time. You pick solo mode (every share is a block attempt, all or nothing) or a normal pool (small steady payouts), and you can switch in the config whenever you like, takes a minute.

Most first-time buyers run pool for a while to learn it, then flip to solo for the block shot. Where would it sit — desk or garage?

Then I'd keep it in the garage. At 650 W it's a real fan — fine in a garage or a workshop, noticeable on a desk in a quiet room.

For a first miner the 40T is our best value per TH at $799, Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026. Want me to put one in a cart?
Do you ship to Sydney, NSW, Australia

Yes — (address hidden)'s fine. One variant, matched to your address; shipping is a $40 flat rate at its 6.8 kg weight. It takes 100–240 V, so it runs on Australian mains; the cord is a type C/F with an adapter for your socket.

Any Australian GST or duty is charged on delivery, not at our checkout. Want me to build the cart?
